lines.en: And they're greetings to you, they sing them and they shout,
lines.zh: 他们向你问好，唱着歌、喊着送上问候

lines.en: But if you meet a Fixie, please, Don't let their secret out!
lines.zh: 但如果你遇到了修理工，千万别泄露他们的秘密！

lines.en: The Wires
lines.zh: 电线

lines.en: Quiet down! Get ready for your lesson!
lines.zh: 安静下来！准备上课！

lines.en: Be quiet! Quiet down, please! It's so hot here!
lines.zh: 安静，拜托。哦

lines.en: In today's class we'll learn about… What was that, huh?
lines.zh: 今天这节课好热，我们要学习……哦，那是什么？

lines.en: It must have been an earthquake.
lines.zh: 嗯？一定是地震了。是的

lines.en: Yeah, it was an earthquake! Hurrah!
lines.zh: 是地震，好耶！

lines.en: Sorry there, Professor.
lines.zh: 对不起，教授。

lines.en: I have to find an outlet so I can plug in this fan.
lines.zh: 哦，我得找个插座插上这个风扇。

lines.en: It feels terribly hot. It sure does.
lines.zh: 哦，感觉好热。真是太难了，确实很难。

lines.en: Well, keep looking. You'll find one.
lines.zh: 继续找，你肯定能找到一个。

lines.en: Now then, where was I? Alright. Today…
lines.zh: 那我刚才说到哪儿了？哦，对了，今天……哦不

lines.en: No! It's impossible! In this whole laboratory there isn't one free outlet!
lines.zh: 这不可能，整个实验室里一个空插座都没有。

lines.en: Look at this!
lines.zh: 你看这个……哦

lines.en: Just pull out one of these wires and then you'll have a free outlet.
lines.zh: 只要拔掉一根电线，你就有一个空插座了。

lines.en: I can't!
lines.zh: 不行

lines.en: I fear I could pull out a plug for something important.
lines.zh: 我怕拔掉什么重要的插头。啊

lines.en: Volt himself would get all tangled up in these wires.
lines.zh: 就算闪电本人也会被这些电线缠住的。

lines.en: Don't worry about it, Professor Eugenius. We'll find a free outlet for you.
lines.zh: 别担心，教授，你真是个天才，我们会帮你找到一个空插座的。

lines.en: That's right, my colleague.
lines.zh: 没错，我的同事。

lines.en: A cup of tea will do you good, so just go relax.
lines.zh: 喝杯茶对你有好处，去放松一下吧。

lines.en: Thank you, my colleague.
lines.zh: 谢谢你，我的同事。

lines.en: And as always, I'm eternally grateful.
lines.zh: 一如既往，我永远感激不尽。

lines.en: Fixies have opened schools for their children in all sorts of different places,
lines.zh: 固定派在各种不同的地方为他们的孩子开办了学校

lines.en: like factories,
lines.zh: 比如工厂

lines.en: stores, and warehouses.
lines.zh: 商店、仓库

lines.en: Anywhere where there's lots of machines and appliances and places to hide from humans.
lines.zh: 任何有很多机器和设备，以及可以躲避人类的地方。

lines.en: And this is where we hold our school,
lines.zh: 而这里就是我们的学校

lines.en: right here inside the laboratory of Professor Eugenius.
lines.zh: 就在尤金尼厄斯教授的实验室里。

lines.en: It's a fantastic place for me to hold class.
lines.zh: 对我来说，这是一个绝佳的上课场所。

lines.en: Every day, new devices, materials, toys, and even food are brought here for examination.
lines.zh: 每天都有新的设备、材料、玩具，甚至食物被带到这里进行研究。

lines.en: And there are lots of scientific devices and tools to study here as well.
lines.zh: 这里还有很多科学仪器和工具可以学习。

lines.en: But most importantly, we never need to hide from the head of the laboratory.
lines.zh: 但最重要的是…… 我们永远不需要躲着实验室主任

lines.en: Because my colleague, Professor Eugenius, is someone I'm proud to call a friend.
lines.zh: 因为我的同事尤金教授是我引以为豪的朋友

lines.en: He loves Fixies,
lines.zh: 他喜欢固定齿轮自行车

lines.en: helps us any time we need, and will never let our secret out.
lines.zh: 随时都会帮助我们，而且我们永远不会泄露我们的秘密。

lines.en: What should we do first?
lines.zh: 我们首先应该做什么？

lines.en: We have to start out with pulling apart these wires.
lines.zh: 我们得先把这些电线分开

lines.en: That'll take a second. Over here! No, here!
lines.zh: 这需要一点时间。

lines.en: Nolik, come help! Let's do this!
lines.zh: 诺利克，来帮忙！我们来吧！

lines.en: Come on, come on, come on, come on, just one more time!
lines.zh: 音乐] 好了。

lines.en: Stop it! I can't get out! Loosen the wires!
lines.zh: 我解不开这些电线

lines.en: We need to pull out this one! Stop this nonsense, will you?
lines.zh: 我们需要把这根拔出来。别胡闹了，好吗？

lines.en: Thank you, Digit! Tideesh!
lines.zh: 嗯

lines.en: Well,
lines.zh: 好吧

lines.en: the way I see it,
lines.zh: 依我看

lines.en: in order to get the knot out that's over here,
lines.zh: 为了解开这边的结

lines.en: we need to expand the loop that's over there,
lines.zh: 我们需要把那边的线圈撑开

lines.en: and then push that wire through it.
lines.zh: 然后把那根电线穿过去

lines.en: And then do it again from the other end.
lines.zh: 再从另一端重复一遍

lines.en: That's it. Very good, girls. Now pull it hard.
lines.zh: 就是这样，很好，姑娘们

lines.en: Perfect. Hey, check it out! The screen wire up here isn't plugged into anything!
lines.zh: 用力拉，完美。嘿，看看，上面的屏幕线没插任何东西

lines.en: Then no one's using it!
lines.zh: 那就说明没人用它

lines.en: So that means we should go and pull it out from the outlet.
lines.zh: 所以我们应该把它从插座上拔下来

lines.en: Got it! Tideesh! Verda!
lines.zh: 明白了吗？

lines.en: Here's another wire that isn't plugged in! I've found another wire no one's using.
lines.zh: 这里还有一根没插的电线，我又找到一根电线。没人用

lines.en: I mean, Simka and I found it together.
lines.zh: 哦，我是说想想，我找到了

lines.en: Nolik, why are you so upset?
lines.zh: 现在舔舔，你为什么这么生气？

lines.en: Because you guys are doing all the work.
lines.zh: 因为你们做了所有的工作。

lines.en: How about this wire? Nobody's checked it yet.
lines.zh: 那这场火呢？

lines.en: Really? Oh, wow! What?
lines.zh: 还没人检查过呢。哦，哇

lines.en: Did you find some treasure, Nolik? Uh -huh!
lines.zh: 你发现了什么？宝藏吗？嗯哼

lines.en: There are six free outlets under here! Great!
lines.zh: 这里下面有六个空插座，太好了！

lines.en: Now Professor Eugenius can plug in his fan, and his kettle,
lines.zh: 现在尤金教授可以插上他的风扇、水壶

lines.en: and even his soldering iron!
lines.zh: 甚至电烙铁了。

lines.en: To get electricity to a device that doesn't use batteries,
lines.zh: 要给不使用电池的设备供电

lines.en: you need to plug a pair of wires into an outlet.
lines.zh: 你需要把两根电线插到插座上

lines.en: But it's important not to let the wires touch one another,
lines.zh: 但重要的是不要让电线互相接触

lines.en: or the electricity can burn them out.
lines.zh: 否则电流会烧坏它们。

lines.en: That's why wires are covered in plastic or rubber,
lines.zh: 这就是为什么电线要用塑料或橡胶包裹的原因

lines.en: so the electricity won't pass from one wire to the other.
lines.zh: 这样电流就不会从一根电线流到另一根电线

lines.en: Or to us when we touch them, so always be very careful with wires.
lines.zh: 也不会在我们触摸它们时流到我们身上。所以一定要非常小心电线

lines.en: And never ever touch a bare wire,
lines.zh: 永远不要触摸裸露的电线

lines.en: you could get killed by the electric shock!
lines.zh: 否则你会被电死的。

lines.en: Oh, what would I do without my wonderful friends?
lines.zh: 哦，没有我这些好朋友我该怎么办？

lines.en: Thank you! Ah, sorry, I just… I didn't…
lines.zh: 谢谢你们。啊，对不起

lines.en: I wanted to… Uh… I should go.
lines.zh: 我只是……我没有……我想……我应该走了。

lines.en: Go ahead. That's a great idea. And we'll start our class.
lines.zh: 去吧，这是个好主意，我们开始上课吧。

lines.en: What were we talking about? All about wires.
lines.zh: 呃，我们刚才在说什么来着？关于……电线

lines.en: Well, it looks like our class is over.
lines.zh: 看来我们这节课要放学了

lines.en: Time to go play!
lines.zh: 该去玩了。你能相信吗？

lines.en: Hard to see their features
lines.zh: 固定齿轮自行车是如此小巧的生物，即使放大也很难看清它们的图片。它们非常小，微乎其微，小到
